text:
Harper Lee: Pitched a compact autoscale row variant that prioritizes contrast + keyboard flow. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/compact-contrast. Key asks: collapsed min/max, explicit burst/surge labeling, and a prominent guardrail indicator.
Diego Rivera: I like the collapsed approach: shows `Min 1 · Max 8` and a tiny chevron to expand. Important: when collapsed the row still needs an offscreen summary for screen readers: `aria-describedby="autoscale-summary-2169998888"`.
Zoe Kim: Copy nit: prefer `Surge tokens (short)` over `Burst` in compact contexts. Tooltip: `Surge tokens borrow spare GPUs for up to X minutes; may change cost.` Mobile short: `Surge (short)`.
Marcus Bell: Contrast nit: badge states (on/disabled) must work without color. Add an icon + text and a 2px high-contrast border for disabled. For focus, use a 3px solid outline that meets 3:1 contrast.
Harper Lee: Interaction: chevron has `aria-expanded` that toggles expanded steppers. Tab order: chevron -> min stepper -> max stepper -> surge toggle -> SLO slider -> info button. Escape collapses and returns focus to chevron.
Diego Rivera: Guardrail behavior: if a change violates guardrail show a persistent banner: `Guardrail warning — this may raise P95 above target. Suggested safe: 450ms.` Actions: `[Apply safe] [Force apply]` with `Force apply` opening a confirm dialog. Banner should have `role=alertdialog`.
Zoe Kim: Accessibility: SLO slider needs `aria-valuetext` like `SLO 300ms — est p95 340ms, +7% cost` while scrubbing. Also add a polite `aria-live` region for estimate updates (debounced 250ms).
Marcus Bell: Edge case: pinned pool with no spare GPUs should render `Surge unavailable · pinned pool` with lock icon and `aria-disabled="true"`. Add CTA `Switch to elastic` that opens pool picker. Don't rely on color.
a11y-bot: Reminder: live region updates should be concise and deduplicated. Use `aria-atomic=true` for the small estimate region and debounce to avoid screen reader spam.
Harper Lee: Visual note: in compact mode show a tiny delta chip next to the slider on hover/focus: `~+7% cost · +40ms`. Default hidden to reduce noise. Keyboard users get same text through the live region.
Diego Rivera: Keyboard affordance for collapsed inline edit: pressing Enter on the collapsed `Min 1 · Max 8` opens a small inline editor (not a modal). Use `role=dialog`? better to keep it inline and focus the first input. Ensure screen reader announces `Autoscale edit dialog expanded inline`.
Zoe Kim: Copy tweak for the surge badge tooltip: shorten to `Temporary spare GPUs up to X mins. May increase cost.` and include an example in expanded view `Est. cost: +$12/day (approx)`. Percent in compact, dollars in expanded details.
Marcus Bell: QA checklist: test NVDA/VoiceOver, keyboard-only, high-contrast theme, and 200% zoom on mobile. Verify focus order when guardrail banner appears.
Harper Lee: I'll update the figma with the offscreen ids, the compact delta chip, and the disabled surge state. Tagging @Zoe for copy and @Marcus for a11y verification. ETA: tomorrow morning. :rocket:
